article_notes: Lung post-mortem pathology in 11 B. rossi dogs (PCR/RLB mono-infection, OVAH) that died or were euthanised with complicated disease, vs 4 control dogs. All infected dogs were treated before death; time from treatment to death not stated. Only fatal cases are included, so there is no severity or outcome comparison: IHC cell counts (MAC387, CD204, CD3, CD20, MUM1, VCAM-1) are infected vs control, and lesion scores are descriptive. Nothing extracted.
